briefings.title: Why AI Demand Is Outrunning Compute Supply
briefings.tldr: Despite public market volatility, AI adoption and infrastructure demand are accelerating rapidly, driven by sub-one-year payback periods on compute and expanding enterprise token consumption.

briefings.title: Anthropic's $2T IPO, Zuck's AI Manifesto, Nvidia's $500B AI Bet, Grok's Comeback
briefings.tldr: Anthropic is reportedly eyeing an October IPO at a staggering $2 trillion valuation on a projected $100B–$120B annual run rate, while Mark Zuckerberg released a major 6,500-word manifesto championing decentralized, open-source AI over centralized "doomer" cartels.

briefings.title: The AI Selloff Doesn't Match the Data | Top AI Investor Explains
briefings.tldr: Public markets experienced a severe, "2022-style" AI sell-off in July 2026, dropping AI and semiconductor stocks 40% to 60%, even as foundational operating cash flows, GPU spot prices, and token demands accelerated on the ground in Silicon Valley.

briefings.title: Episode 56: Gavin Baker - Managing Partner of Atreides Management
briefings.tldr: Gavin Baker argues that the current AI cycle is not a valuation bubble but a transformative revolution structurally limited by a shortage of "watts and wafers," emphasizing that long-term investment success requires matching one's strategy to their unique emotional resilience.

briefings.title: The SpaceX IPO, Fable 5, AI Capex Update & Market Check w/ Gavin Baker, Andrew Fox & Clark Tang
briefings.tldr: The upcoming SpaceX IPO at $135 per share (implied $1.77 trillion valuation) represents a generational, "must-own" asset, driven not only by the rapid scaling of its core launch and Starlink businesses, but by its sudden, highly profitable emergence as a top-tier terrestrial and orbital AI compute provider.

briefings.title: Why Secondary Markets Are Eating the IPO | All-In Liquidity Secondary Markets Panel
briefings.tldr: The secondary market has reached record volumes, doubling its 2021 peak to become a primary liquidity mechanism that actively competes with IPOs.

briefings.title: SpaceX’s $2T Case, Nvidia’s Shock Selloff, America Turns on AI, Trump Pulls AI Order, Bond Crisis?
briefings.tldr: SpaceX’s massive S-1 filing outlines a path to a $2 trillion valuation driven by Starlink’s high-margin profitability and a blockbuster $15 billion-per-year compute rental deal with Anthropic, even as Nvidia posts historic earnings and the broader AI sector faces a growing public relations and macroeconomic backlash.

briefings.title: Gavin Baker on Orbital Compute, TSMC, and Frontier Models
briefings.tldr: The artificial intelligence expansion represents the most extraordinary acceleration of revenue and compute demand in the history of capitalism, driven by unprecedented inflections like Anthropic’s massive ARR growth.
